body: When lesson_registry.py status <id> enforced succeeds (E2a) and the lesson's target_path resolves to a rule line naming a backing script, stamp that line with an explicit (enforcement: hook|stop-gate|ci) tag so determinism_gap_scan.py stops reporting it as an untagged GAP once the hook is wired. Closes the loop between the lesson lifecycle (candidate->recorded->promoted->enforced) and the per-rule enforcement-tag mechanism shipped in project-meta 1.28.0. Terminology note: lesson 'enforced' = evidence graduation; '(enforcement: ...)' tag = mechanical wiring intent — keep vocabularies distinct.
title: Wire lesson 'enforced' status to determinism enforcement tags

body: Symmetry gap: lessons auto-demote on stale evidence (DASH-075) but hooks/gates have no expiry lifecycle. Adopt Anthropic 'harnesses encode assumptions that go stale' doctrine (managed-agents post, 2026-04-08) + Osmani rule (add on seen failure, remove when a capable model makes it redundant, 04-19): annotate each hook/gate with the model deficiency it compensates; re-test annotations on every model upgrade via a harness smoke checklist (also covers tool-schema drift — Ronacher 'Better Models: Worse Tools' 07-04).
title: hook/gate 'compensates-for' expiry annotations + post-model-upgrade smoke suite

title: measure harness fixed overhead + cache hit rate (systima methodology)
